OOMOL_CONNECT_ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Admin token: paste it into the web console to sign in. Also authorizes the admin API.

OOMOL_CONNECT_RUNTIME_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for agents calling /v1 and /mcp. Without it those endpoints would be open to anyone. You can also mint scoped tokens in the console.

OOMOL_CONNECT_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encrypts stored credentials and OAuth secrets on the volume. Never change or lose it - encrypted data can't be recovered without it.

OOMOL_CONNECT_ORIGIN.description: Public URL used for OAuth redirect URLs - switch it to your custom domain after adding one.

PORT.description: Port the runtime listens on - leave as is.
